notes: Curated employer listings checked on 2 October 2026; availability may change. Read the employer’s current listing before applying.
SAIN lists three paid roles and seven volunteer opportunities. The Groningen team currently lists no vacancies. Volunteer roles are labelled separately.
Broader AI listings are skills or research opportunities, not an endorsement of their impact on frontier-AI safety. Relevance labels are editorial.
Work arrangements and visa sponsorship are not inferred. “Not specified” means the listing did not clearly establish them. Entry-level PhDs still require the qualifications stated by the employer.
Expanded on 2 October 2026 with 49 additional employer-sourced academic, public-sector and industry adverts. Each advert counts once; adverts for multiple positions may represent more than one hire.
Only explicitly advertised Dutch work cities receive map pins. Multiple eligible cities share one advert. City dots mark sourced city centres, not exact office addresses.
Where a source says to apply before a date, the displayed last application day is the preceding calendar day. Confirm the exact time and conditions on the employer page.
Broader AI includes applied research, engineering and supporting roles at AI organisations; these are not necessarily jobs that reduce frontier AI risk.
